comment: Each entry pins a compiler subsystem to (a) the C++ entry points that
implement it, (b) a d8 trace configuration that proves the input reached
it, and (c) a seed harness under seeds/ that reaches it.
'hit_patterns' are Python regular expressions matched against the
combined stdout/stderr of the traced Maglev run; any match counts as a
'required_patterns' must *each* match at least once, for targets whose
reachability needs more than one trace signature (e.g. an allocation node

trigger: for-in over a plain object with an intact enum cache reaches the
kEnumCacheKeys lowering; a Proxy receiver forces ForInHint::kAny and
the generic ForInPrepare/ForInNext nodes.
bug_classes: stale enum cache / CheckDynamicValue deopt loop
ForInNext lazy deopt frame with the wrong accumulator
CacheIndicesNotCleared check removed by an optimisation

trigger: loop phi whose incoming values alternate between Smi and heap
number; the pass must either pick Float64 for the phi or insert
conversions, and the bisection path is driven by the number of
conflicting uses.
bug_classes: wrong representation for a phi after a back edge
missing conversion at a deopt/merge point
miscompiled tagged use of an untagged phi

trigger: loop Phi merges a Smi-representation field load and a HeapNumber
field across the back edge; the Phi is untagged to Float64 and its
tagged consumer expects a HeapObject (length/element access), so the
CheckHeapObject that used to guard that use has to survive the
untagging.
bug_classes: HeapObjectness dropped from the Phi type
CheckHeapObject elided after untagging
retagged HeapNumber reaching a property access

trigger: loop header Phi is Smi; backedge merges a HeapNumber
on the last iteration; the header type is used without
re-checking the backedge; the Phi is untagged as Float64
and the post-loop retag is wrong
bug_classes: backedge type not re-validated
promote_post_loop_type rewrites Phi type with stale union
UnsafeSmiUntag on a HeapNumber backedge

trigger: monomorphic small callee (direct inlining) plus a call site with
two targets (polymorphic inlining tree, --maglev-poly-calls).
bug_classes: wrong arguments object / context after inlining
deopt frame of an inlined callee pointing at the wrong sfi
polymorphic dispatch tree with a missing map check

trigger: object/array literals lowered to AllocationBlock + InlinedAllocation;
the escape-analysis fixpoint classifies each one, and the elider
removes the non-escaping ones (a context whose only uses sit in the
unreachable tail after a cold-call deopt). The seed also builds an
allocation that does escape (stored into a global).
bug_classes: allocation elided although it escaped (loads forwarded wrongly)
store to a captured allocation dropped
virtual object materialised with the wrong map/offset

trigger: a load whose map is cached in KnownNodeAspects, followed by a call
that mutates the receiver (representation change, map transition,
dictionary-mode conversion, elements-kind change), followed by a
second load of the same field.
bug_classes: stale map assumption after a store with a different representation
missing invalidation after dictionary-mode conversion
elements-kind check dropped for an indexed load

trigger: loops with a small statically known trip count, branches in the
body, early exits and nested loops; the peeler duplicates the body
and remaps phis/values, with the optimistic-peeling fallback when
the loop end state is incompatible.
bug_classes: value/phi mapping wrong after cloning
side effect dropped or duplicated in the peeled iteration
peeled loop deopts into a corrupted frame

trigger: nodes used only in 32-bit contexts (|0, bitwise ops, shifts) so
that the pass rewrites Int32AddWithOverflow to Int32Add and elides
identity Int32BitwiseOr nodes.
bug_classes: int32 truncation of a value that is later used as tagged
overflow check dropped for a value that can overflow
range information not updated after truncation

trigger: many simultaneously live values in different register classes,
values live across calls (caller-saved), and live values at merge
points, so that the allocator emits gap moves and spills.
bug_classes: swapped gap-move sources (parallel move bug)
spill slot reused while a value is still live
wrong register class for an untagged value

trigger: %OptimizeOsr() from inside a hot loop with Smi, double and tagged
loop-carried values, plus a nested loop: the OSR entry has to
reconstruct the full interpreter frame at the loop header.
bug_classes: OSR frame state with the wrong register/accumulator
loop phis not initialised from the interpreter frame
OSR entry into a peeled loop with inconsistent state

trigger: three %DisableEagerInlining-marked callees called from one driver;
the first mutates the field whose Smi-representation load the others
re-read, so each callee's entry KnownNodeAspects is a snapshot taken
before the mutation body was spliced in. The graph builder elides the
Smi checks (UnsafeSmiUntag) while the store's own parameter check is
still emitted, so both behaviours appear in one graph.
bug_classes: stale NodeInfo::type_ eliding CheckSmi and producing an UnsafeSmiUntag
stale static type after promote_post_loop_type
loaded_constant_properties_ reuse across an inlined store

trigger: callee has a CheckedSmiUntag whose Smi proof is local to the
callee's call site; the caller is warmed with Smi, then called
with a HeapNumber; the inliner replaces the CheckedSmiUntag
without re-checking the caller's argument type
bug_classes: CheckedSmiUntag replaced after inlining
Smi proof does not survive inlining
write barrier elided on a false Smi proof

trigger: object field is Smi-typed from warmup; a HeapNumber whose
value equals a Smi (5.0 vs 5, -0.0 vs 0) is stored; the
check that should reject it is elided; the store omits the
write barrier; a subsequent GC observes the wrong repr
bug_classes: value equality treated as representation equality
BuildCheckSmi elided on CheckFloat64SameValue
write barrier elided on a HeapNumber store

trigger: fallback target: any seed, no reachability requirement. Useful for
mutation campaigns where the marker of interest is produced by a
flag combination rather than by a fixed trace flag.
bug_classes: any
